page: Google Cloud Platform z4d-highmem-32-highlssd is a storage-optimized virtual machine configured with 32 dedicated vCPUs on an x86_64 architecture. The system features 252.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 7.88 GB of RAM per core. It does not include any graphics processing units and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

A defining characteristic of this server type is its integrated local storage capacity. It is bundled with 15,032 GB of local NVMe SSD storage distributed across four local SSD drives. This high-density local storage configuration is designed to support workloads requiring high-throughput, low-latency data access directly on the physical host.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the z4d-highmem-32-highlssd offers high resource density by combining a substantial memory footprint with massive local NVMe storage on a dedicated CPU allocation. This hardware profile is optimized for data-intensive workloads, including large-scale relational databases, NoSQL databases, real-time analytics, and high-performance file systems that benefit from localized, high-capacity storage.
